requestAccountSettings.reason: Thin settings-only adapter over the certified owned AccountCollectionRead, registered with the containing request/background output owner. Off calls literal AccountCollections; missing/closed owner errors release the graph. SW127 compares exact native/missing values and both owner lifetimes. This helper does not certify unmigrated AccountCollections consumers.
requestAccountSettings.temperatureReason: Shared adapter prepared for HOT account-settings consumers.

accountCollections.reason: store.AccountCollections reads the installed in-memory image, which a bounded store holds without user settings and passkeys (SW530: GET /api/account/settings answered empty settings). Flag off it calls AccountCollections literally; bounded it copies the same values (workspace existence, the user's settings, passkeys in source order when asked) out of the reviewed BeginAccountCollectionRead before closing it; a failed bounded read reports the workspace missing. Every AccountCollections caller (account settings, passkeys, MFA, commit signing key, comment actions, coding) uses it.
accountCollections.temperatureReason: Account settings, passkey and MFA reads are HOT.
